assessment: The advisory is an unmaintained notice with no patched version. This exception accepts maintenance risk for 30 days; it does not assert absence of undiscovered vulnerabilities.

cargo tree --manifest-path programs/agenc-coordination/Cargo.toml --locked -i bincode resolves exactly 1.3.3 through anchor-lang 0.32.1, solana-instruction 2.3.3 and solana-sysvar 2.3.0. The fuzz and zkvm locks do not contain bincode.

The protocol crate has no direct bincode dependency or bincode API calls. Anchor's loader-state decoder uses bincode on UpgradeableLoaderState; its Account wrapper checks ownership. Solana's sysvar decoder checks the sysvar address. Instruction serialization also uses bincode. These observations narrow the reviewed exposure; they are not a complete transitive call-graph audit.
Replacing bincode with another serializer or upgrading Anchor requires explicit wire-format and SBF compatibility work. A lockfile-only replacement is not supported by this pinned dependency graph.

The existing validator continues to bind the exception to one exact package, checksum, lockfile, owner set and bounded date window. All other advisories remain errors. Daily CI and the process-level expiry regression prevent this renewal from becoming indefinite.
removalCondition: Remove this exception when the supported Anchor/Solana graph eliminates bincode 1.3.3. Re-review before 2026-11-18 if that migration remains unavailable; never extend only to make CI green.
